title: What happened in AI — Oct 12, 2026
intro: Production agent practice led the day: Anthropic, Coinbase and Spotify each described how they coordinate, evaluate or control agent-driven work at scale.
On the infrastructure side, vLLM reported up to 3.3x lower TTFT for multi-turn agent workloads, while Chinese labs drew funding and new model releases.
highlights: Anthropic explains how dynamic workflows coordinate Claude agents on larger projects.
Coinbase details building, evaluating and post-training a fraud agent.
Spotify more than doubled monthly code changes with AI and is tightening quality controls.
vLLM bi-directional KV transfer cuts multi-turn TTFT by up to 3.3x.
DeepSeek backs a $400M robotics lab; Z.ai ships GLM-Legal.

categories.name: Agent Orchestration and Production Agents
categories.summary: Teams are publishing how they coordinate, evaluate and post-train agents in production, not just prototype them.
